description: Reference BOMBKI.EXE load-image regions. Offsets are relative to the first byte after the MZ header. Unit segment starts are recovered from original EXE far-call targets; unit extents use the retained byte-identical TPUs and TP7 code lengths.

regions.name: BOMBKI
regions.evidence: MZ CS=0000 and SWIAT far-call segment 0x0F5D; main image ends at the next linked segment.

regions.name: SWIAT
regions.evidence: Original far-call paragraph 0x0F5D; same-build TPU/EXE region mapping in reconstruction-log.md finding 33.

regions.name: PRZEDM
regions.evidence: Original far-call paragraph 0x129D; PRZEDM code extent from retained TPU/TP7 MAP.

regions.name: MONSTRA
regions.evidence: Original WSTEP far-call paragraph 0x1BC4 at img 0x16F9; code extent from retained TPU/TP7 MAP.

regions.name: Crt
regions.evidence: Original CRT far-call paragraph 0x1C0F; code extent from retained TP7 MAP.

regions.name: System
regions.evidence: Original System far-call paragraph 0x1C71; extent 0xD7B matches the candidate TP7 MAP and the 22 trailing bytes (F8 C3 BSS-clear epilogue plus two zero pad bytes) are byte-identical in both images at the same segment-relative offset, ending at img 0x1D48B with three zero pad bytes before DGROUP at 0x1D490.

regions.name: DGROUP
regions.evidence: System bootstrap at original img 0xB0CF sets DGROUP paragraph 0x1D49 and clears BSS through offset 0x08EE; candidate MAP names the corresponding region DATA.
